messages.Shared page: the same in every language,: Shared page: the same in every language, interface in the visitor's language.
You are not allowed to do this.
messages.After saving you can create translations: After saving you can create translations in other languages.
messages.With Flux AI installed, translation is o: With Flux AI installed, translation is one click; AI agents connected over MCP can also translate with the flxl_save_translation tool.
messages.Some sections could not be translated an: Some sections could not be translated and stayed in Turkish. Check them in the editor.
messages.Replace the title, excerpt and body of t: Replace the title, excerpt and body of the existing translation with an AI translation?
messages.Translate with AI? If you choose No, a d: Translate with AI? If you choose No, a draft copy is created for you to translate yourself.
messages.The default language has no prefix in th: The default language has no prefix in the address (example.org/hakkimizda/); other languages open with a prefix such as /en/. Each language version of a content is a separate page/post: create it from the language badge in the list or from the Language box in the editor. Theme and plugin interface texts use their own translations.
messages.Name: Name
messages.A new language is added inactive: prepar: A new language is added inactive: prepare its content, then activate it. Languages other than English also need the WordPress language pack (System check warns).
messages.Cart, checkout and my account pages are: Cart, checkout and my account pages are shared by all languages. Categories are shared; their names are translated per language on the category edit screen. Language-specific alt text and replacement images are on the media edit screen.
messages.Show the Turkish version in other langua: Show the Turkish version in other languages (menu and interface stay in that language; search engines get the Turkish canonical address)
messages.When off, the English site lists only co: When off, the English site lists only content that has an English version.
messages.Elsewhere: the \"Flux Language Switcher\: Elsewhere: the "Flux Language Switcher" block or the [flx_dil_secici] shortcode.
messages.Show a suggestion bar at the top of the: Show a suggestion bar at the top of the page
messages.Visitors from outside Türkiye open the v: Visitors from outside Türkiye open the version in their language (English if none) before the page renders, and stay in it on later visits. A visitor who picks another language in the switcher stays in it. Search engine bots are never redirected. If the country or time zone is Türkiye, the visitor stays in Turkish. Not applied to logged-in users; use a private window to test.
messages.If the browser language is one of the ac: If the browser language is one of the active languages (e.g. German once added), that one is suggested; otherwise this one.
messages.Country in your request: %1$s (%2$s head: Country in your request: %1$s (%2$s header). Country-based suggestion works.
messages.The server sends no country information;: The server sends no country information; the browser's time zone is used (Türkiye time = Turkish). For more accurate results, put the domain behind Cloudflare (free plan, the CF-IPCountry header is used automatically) or enable your host's GeoIP header.
Empty fields are shown in Turkish.
messages.With Flux AI installed, a \"Translate wi: With Flux AI installed, a "Translate with AI" button appears in the list and the editor. AI agents connected over MCP (Claude etc.) and the Flux AI chat use these tools: flxl_languages, flxl_untranslated, flxl_translations, flxl_save_translation, flxl_set_language, flxl_image_language, flxl_term_translation, flxl_site_texts. Flux SEO tools (list_content, create_content, update_content) have a lang parameter.
messages.Source content not found or this type is: Source content not found or this type is not translated.
The content is already in this language.
messages.Flux AI & MCP is not installed or not re: Flux AI & MCP is not installed or not ready.
The AI answer was cut off.
Translation job not found or expired.
messages.ID of the image shown instead of this on: ID of the image shown instead of this one in this language (e.g. the translated version of a poster with text). Empty: same image.
messages.Only the default language is active; the: Only the default language is active; the site is single-language.
messages.Not installed: %s. Pick it once in Setti: Not installed: %s. Pick it once in Settings › General › Site Language and save (the pack downloads), then switch back.
messages.All active languages have WordPress tran: All active languages have WordPress translations.
messages.Untranslated ones are shown in Turkish (: Untranslated ones are shown in Turkish (canonical address is Turkish).
messages.Untranslated ones are hidden in this lan: Untranslated ones are hidden in this language.
messages.No visitor has been checked for a langua: No visitor has been checked for a language suggestion yet.
messages.The server sends no country information;: The server sends no country information; the browser time zone is used (Türkiye time = Turkish). If Cloudflare is enabled, the country code is used automatically.
messages.Country information comes from the %s he: Country information comes from the %s header.
messages.Plain (?p=) links are in use; choose the: Plain (?p=) links are in use; choose the "Post name" structure for language addresses.
messages.If left empty, the Turkish name and desc: If left empty, the Turkish name and description are shown.
messages.Makes the site multilingual: language ad: Makes the site multilingual: language addresses like /en/, translation per page, post, project and event, language-specific visual, hreflang and canonical, English recommendation for those coming from outside Turkey, language selector; Language support for Flux AI & MCP and Flux AI tools.
